snippet.title: Tremen - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1641570?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=youtube

TREMEN is a classic FPS that combines modern graphics with old school gameplay, based on the graphic novels by Pim Bos.

You start as a newly prepared avatar slave in an underground cell, being remotely controlled by a young boy who is about to send you into action in a desperate attempt to destroy the mutant overlords that enslaved humanity for consumption.

Use a varied arsenal of upgradeable weapons, ranging from laser guns to shocks rifles, as you butcher the mutiple enemies that obstruct your path, including grenade launching mutant bodybuilders and electricity shooting obese dominatrices.

Features:
- Fight your way through 24 brutalistic levels, spread over six different environments
- Battle twenty different enemy types, ranging from rabid pigs to obese dominatrices with electro
- Wield an arsenal of ten upgradable weapons to help you with your splatterfest
- All underscored by an original heavy metal soundtrack by Closed Grip

The game offers highly addictive fast paced action in ominous environments that keep the player wanting for more.

©2026 JanduSoft & Red Meat Entertainment
